categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of AIDC (Automatic Identification and Data Collection) terminal products including smart data terminals (PDA), smart payment terminals (smart POS), specialized printers, and intelligent automation equipment. It also provides related software and cloud service platforms. Key industry applications include logistics, e-commerce, retail, manufacturing, healthcare, public utilities, law enforcement, and finance.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages core technologies such as barcode recognition, machine vision, RFID, AI visual algorithms, edge computing, blockchain, and OpenHarmony operating system adaptation. Manufacturing involves industrial-grade smart terminals with integrated hardware and software, including proprietary chipsets and customized software solutions. Production is mainly in-house with some outsourcing to professional OEMs when demand exceeds capacity.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers span logistics and express delivery, e-commerce, retail, manufacturing, healthcare, food and pharmaceuticals, public utilities, law enforcement, and financial sectors. The company serves both domestic and international markets, focusing on industry clients requiring digital transformation and intelligent data collection solutions.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with significant overseas market expansion in Europe, Southeast Asia, Africa, India, Latin America, and the Middle East. It maintains a global sales and service network and actively pursues international certifications to support its global footprint.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, focusing on manufacturing and selling finished AIDC hardware products and providing integrated software and cloud services. It also engages in upstream R&D of core technologies and components.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include deepening integration of AIDC with AI and IoT technologies, advancing OpenHarmony-based operating systems, enhancing edge computing capabilities, and promoting domestic chip and software ecosystem development. The company emphasizes innovation in AI visual recognition, digital RMB payment solutions, RFID applications, and intelligent automation equipment. It plans to expand R&D in data operation and SaaS services while strengthening supply chain diversification and security.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of smart terminals, specialized printers, and related hardware. Additional income comes from software development, cloud services, and customized integrated solutions sold via direct sales, distributors, and system integrators. The company also benefits from government subsidies and investment income.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic AIDC enterprise with a comprehensive product portfolio covering data collection and generation terminals. It competes with global brands like Zebra and Epson in hardware, and domestic firms such as Newland and Fujian Newland in smart terminals and POS devices. Its competitive advantages include high cost-performance products, customization capabilities, and integrated service solutions, especially in emerging overseas markets.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 1.22 billion, a slight decline from the previous year, with a net loss attributable to shareholders of about RMB 150 million, mainly due to goodwill impairment and foreign exchange losses. R&D investment increased by over 12%, reflecting a focus on innovation. The company maintains total assets around RMB 2.06 billion and equity of RMB 1.34 billion, with ongoing efforts to improve operational efficiency and expand market share domestically and internationally.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes delivering high cost-performance industrial-grade smart terminals with integrated hardware-software solutions tailored to diverse industry needs. Its unique value lies in comprehensive AIDC product coverage, advanced AI and edge computing integration, strong customization and one-stop service capabilities, and active participation in domestic digital infrastructure initiatives such as digital RMB and OpenHarmony ecosystems. This positions the company as a strategic partner for digital transformation across multiple sectors.
